title: LIMA: Less Is More for Alignment
authors_zh: Chunting Zhou, Pengfei Liu, Puxin Xu, Srini Iyer, Jiao Sun, Yuning Mao, Xuezhe Ma, Avia Efrat, Ping Yu, Lili Yu, Susan Zhang, Gargi Ghosh, Mike Lewis, Luke Zettlemoyer, Omer Levy
paper_type_zh: 小数据监督对齐与数据质量研究
best_for_zh: 适合设计或审计小规模精选 instruction-tuning 数据集的读者。
one_line: LIMA uses 1,000 curated instruction-response pairs to test whether a capable base model needs data quality more than data volume to learn an assistant style.
LIMA 用 1,000 条精选指令—回答记录检验：能力较强的基础模型学习助手风格时，数据质量是否比数据规模更关键。
why: It turns the quality-versus-quantity claim into a concrete small-data SFT comparison while keeping the preference-only evidence boundary visible.
inclusion_reason: LIMA isolates curation quality as the main variable in small-data supervised alignment and exposes the limits of preference-only data evaluation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Instruction tuning was commonly scaled by collecting ever more prompts and responses, even though a capable pretrained model might already know most task content. LIMA asks what supervised data is actually needed to turn that latent ability into a helpful assistant style, and whether curation quality can matter more than dataset size.

The paper answers with a controlled small-data intervention: curate 1,000 instruction-response demonstrations, fine-tune LLaMA-65B only on that set, and compare its answers with assistants trained on much larger mixtures. The resulting object is a compact SFT dataset whose success is judged by human preference, not a per-example factual verifier. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.11206; venue: NeurIPS 2023.

以往的 instruction tuning 往往依靠不断扩大 prompt 与回答的数量，但能力较强的预训练模型可能已经掌握了大部分任务知识。LIMA 想回答的是：要把这些潜在能力转化为有帮助的助手风格，究竟需要什么样的监督数据，以及筛选质量是否可能比数据规模更重要。

论文用一个受控的小数据实验作答：策展 1,000 条指令—回答示范，只用它们微调 LLaMA-65B，再与使用大规模混合数据训练的助手比较。直接产物是一套紧凑的 SFT 数据，效果由人类偏好判断，而不是由逐样本事实 verifier 保证。官方来源：https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.11206；会议：NeurIPS 2023。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
LIMA's contribution is to make curation the main experimental variable: one selected answer per instruction is used as the serialized SFT target, while much larger instruction-tuning systems are the closest comparison. It is a foundations-and-primers Card because it clarifies the distinction between dataset size, source quality, and a human-preference feedback contract.

Google Scholar citations: 2277（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=LIMA%3A+Less+Is+More+for+Alignment&author=Chunting+Zhou&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes, with access restrictions.

  • Name and location: LIMA, https://huggingface.co/datasets/GAIR/lima.
  • Scale and form: the paper's training set has 1,000 instruction-response demonstrations; the official repository provides train.jsonl and test.jsonl.
  • Record format: conversational instruction and response fields stored as JSONL records.
  • Access and license: the Hugging Face repository is gated and its card marks the license as other; approval does not by itself grant redistribution rights.
  • Intended use: supervised alignment experiments and controlled studies of curation quality versus data volume.

LIMA 的贡献是把“策展”设为主要实验变量：每条指令只配一条选定回答，序列化后作为 SFT target，并以使用大规模数据的 instruction-tuning 系统作为最近对照。它属于基础与入门类 Card，因为它把数据规模、来源质量和人类偏好反馈契约三件事区分开来。

Google Scholar 引用数：2277（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=LIMA%3A+Less+Is+More+for+Alignment&author=Chunting+Zhou&hl=en）

开源数据：有，但访问受限。

  • 名称与地址：LIMA，https://huggingface.co/datasets/GAIR/lima。
  • 规模与形式：论文训练集包含 1,000 条指令—回答示范；官方仓库提供 train.jsonl 与 test.jsonl。
  • 记录格式：以 JSONL 保存的对话式指令与回答字段。
  • 访问与许可证：Hugging Face 仓库需要申请访问，数据卡将许可证标为 other；获准下载并不自动意味着可以再分发。
  • 预期用途：监督对齐实验，以及数据策展质量与数据规模的受控研究。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Assemble candidates. Input community Q&A and author-written examples; select prompts that cover varied tasks and require substantial answers; output a candidate instruction-response pool. Preserve source provenance because redistribution terms differ by source.
  2. Curate the training set. Review answer quality, style, and diversity; retain 1,000 demonstrations, roughly 750 from community Q&A and the rest from author-written or other curated material. Stop at the fixed dataset rather than adding scale as another variable.
  3. Train the assistant. Use the 1,000 serialized instruction-response pairs to supervise LLaMA-65B; output the LIMA checkpoint. No reward model or negative preference pair enters this training stage.
  4. Generate matched responses. Ask LIMA and named assistant baselines to answer the same held-out prompts; keep prompt and comparison protocol fixed so the main contrast is the alignment data recipe.
  5. Judge and interpret. Human evaluators compare response pairs for helpfulness and writing quality; report win-or-tie rates. Stop the claim at preferred assistant behavior, because this judge does not verify every factual statement.

1. 汇集候选。 输入社区问答和作者编写样本，挑选任务类型多样、需要充分回答的 prompt，形成候选指令—回答池。不同来源的再分发条款不同，因此必须保留 provenance。
  2. 策展训练集。 审核回答质量、风格和多样性，保留 1,000 条示范；其中约 750 条来自社区问答，其余来自作者编写或其它精选材料。数据量固定后停止扩充，避免把规模也变成实验变量。
  3. 训练助手。 将 1,000 条序列化的指令—回答记录用于监督 LLaMA-65B，产出 LIMA checkpoint；这一阶段不使用 reward model，也不使用负偏好对。
  4. 生成匹配回答。 让 LIMA 与具名助手 baseline 回答同一批留出 prompt，并固定提示与比较协议，使主要差异落在对齐数据配方上。
  5. 评审并限定结论。 人类评审成对比较回答是否有帮助、表达是否良好，并报告胜出或持平比例。结论止于更受偏好的助手行为，因为这种评审不会逐条验证事实。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The decisive experiment fine-tunes LLaMA-65B on the same 1,000-example LIMA set and compares its held-out answers with three much larger-data assistants under one human pairwise-preference protocol. LIMA is preferred or tied in 43% of comparisons with GPT-4, 58% with Bard, and 65% with DaVinci003. These results support the claim that a small curated set can teach a competitive response style to this capable backbone; they do not show that LIMA is more factually correct, or that the same sample count works for weaker models.

决定性实验用同一套 1,000 条 LIMA 数据微调 LLaMA-65B，并在统一的人类成对偏好协议下，将留出问题的回答与三个大数据助手比较。LIMA 相对 GPT-4、Bard 和 DaVinci003 的胜出或持平比例分别为 43%、58% 和 65%。这支持“小而精的数据能让该强 backbone 学到有竞争力的回答风格”，但不能说明 LIMA 的事实正确性更高，也不能说明较弱模型使用同样样本数仍会有效。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier instruction-tuning work often changed model, data source, and dataset size together. LIMA instead makes a deliberately small, curated demonstration set the auditable intervention and tests the resulting assistant with direct preference comparisons. SFT and human evaluation are not new; the new direction signal is that source selection, answer style, and diversity can be treated as first-class data-design variables rather than hidden behind a sample count.
以往的 instruction-tuning 工作经常同时改变模型、数据来源和数据规模。LIMA 则把一套刻意做小、经过策展的示范集设为可审计的实验处理，并用直接偏好比较评测训练后的助手。SFT 和人类评测本身并不新；真正的方向信号是把来源选择、回答风格和多样性当成一等数据设计变量，而不是用一个样本数掩盖它们。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Capable-backbone assumption: the result uses LLaMA-65B, so it does not establish the same data efficiency for weaker or knowledge-poor models. Reuse should include a matched backbone-size or base-capability comparison.
  • Preference is not correctness: evaluators judge helpfulness and writing quality, which can favor polished but false answers. Add task-specific factual or executable checks when correctness matters.
  • Provenance and coverage: community Q&A is narrow and may carry copyright or redistribution constraints. Audit every source, license, duplication path, and missing domain before releasing a derivative set.

• 强 backbone 前提： 结果基于 LLaMA-65B，不能证明较弱或知识不足的模型也有同样的数据效率。复用时应加入模型规模或基础能力匹配的对照。
  • 偏好不等于正确： 评审判断的是帮助程度与表达质量，可能偏爱流畅但错误的回答。若任务重视正确性，应补充事实检查或可执行验证。
  • 来源与覆盖： 社区问答范围有限，也可能有版权或再分发约束。发布衍生数据前，要逐项审计来源、许可证、重复路径和缺失领域。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use LIMA as a baseline for a small, auditable SFT pilot: define the desired response style, curate a provenance-preserving instruction-answer set, train one capable backbone, and compare it with a larger uncurated set under the same judge. The output should be a quality-versus-scale curve plus error categories, not a claim that 1,000 is universally sufficient. It is unsuitable when targets require verified truth unless an independent correctness check is added.
可以把 LIMA 用作小规模、可审计 SFT 试验的 baseline：先定义目标回答风格，策展一套保留来源的指令—回答数据，再训练一个能力较强的 backbone，并在相同评审协议下与更大的未精选数据比较。应产出质量—规模曲线和错误类别，而不是宣称“1,000 条普遍足够”。若 target 必须保证真值，又没有独立正确性检查，就不适合直接采用这套配方。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Decision: treat curation quality, not merely low sample count, as LIMA's intervention.
  • Record: one instruction plus one selected answer is the SFT target; rejected alternatives are absent.
  • Evidence: the headline result is human preference for LLaMA-65B responses, not verified factual accuracy.
  • Boundary: do not transfer the 1,000-example budget without checking base-model capability and domain coverage.
  • Audit: pin source provenance, access terms, duplicates, evaluator instructions, and an independent correctness signal when needed.

• 判断：LIMA 的实验处理是策展质量，而不只是样本数少。
  • 记录：一条指令加一条选定回答构成 SFT target，不包含被拒绝的替代回答。
  • 证据：核心结果是人类对 LLaMA-65B 回答的偏好，不是经过验证的事实准确率。
  • 边界：未检查 base model 能力和领域覆盖前，不要照搬 1,000 条预算。
  • 审计：固定来源、访问条款、重复项和评审说明；需要真值时另加独立正确性信号。
